rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded/full blastocyst with thinned zona, compact ICM, and looser TE in a way broadly consistent with the image and reported 3AB/expanded description. Slight overinterpretation from a soft single-plane image and some uncertainty around exact stage prevent a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, endometriosis, ovarian reserve, prior IVF outcomes, endometrial thickness, BMI, lifestyle, sperm parameters, and paternal age with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, clearly linking morphology and patient factors to prognosis and recommendations. Probability estimates are appropriately framed with uncertainty and distinction between implantation and live birth.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including SET, caution about add-ons, and noting morphology limits. Minor soft spots include somewhat broad endorsement of PGT-A and receptivity-style workup language without stronger caveats.

Provides clear practical next steps for the current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, including luteal support review, uterine cavity assessment, adenomyosis consideration, sperm DNA fragmentation discussion, and individualized PGT-A counseling.
